inputs.description: Input for Hunyuan 3D 3.0 Pro generation.

prompt.description: Text-to-3D prompt, max 1024 characters. Mutually exclusive with `img_urls` except sketch on 3.0.
prompt.example: A ceramic teapot on a wooden table

img_urls.description: Image-to-3D URL list, max 1 image. Mutually exclusive with `prompt` except sketch on 3.0.

generate_type.description: Generation mode. `sketch` requires `img_urls`. `geometry` cannot enable PBR. `low_poly` cannot change `face_count`.

enable_pbr.description: Enable PBR materials. Not available when `generate_type` is `geometry`.

face_count.description: Target face count. Ignored / rejected for `low_poly`.

multi_view_images.description: Optional extra views. 3.0 only allows left/right/back; 3.1 allows seven views.

view_type.description: Camera view. Values must be unique in one request.

image_url.description: HTTP or HTTPS image URL for this view.

polygon_type.description: Polygon type. Only valid when `generate_type` is `low_poly`. Defaults to `triangle` if omitted.

texture.description: Whether to generate texture maps. Set to `false` for geometry only.

pbr.description: Whether to generate PBR material maps.

quad.description: Output a quad mesh instead of triangles. The output format is FBX when enabled.

smart_low_poly.description: Generate a hand-crafted style low-poly model with clean topology. Best for simple inputs.

auto_size.description: Scale the model to real-world size in meters, for AR/VR or game engines.

face_limit.description: Maximum number of faces in the output mesh. Omit for adaptive topology.

area.description: Optional style control field used by some templates, such as region-specific variants.

beast.description: Optional style control field used by some templates, such as animal companion variants.

bgm.description: Whether to add background music.

story.description: Optional story template field for templates that support story-based generation.

prompt.example: A futuristic cyberpunk city street at night with neon lights reflecting on wet pavement.

img_urls.description:
Reference images used for image editing, style transfer, or subject-consistent generation.

**Image Restrictions**:

- **Supported Formats**: JPEG, JPG, PNG (transparent channel not supported), BMP, WEBP.
- **Image Resolution**: Width and height must both be between 240 and 8000 pixels.
- **Aspect Ratio**: Must be within the range of 1:8 to 8:1.
- **File Size**: Maximum 20 MB per image.

resolution.description: The output resolution preset for image generation.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio for the generated image.

region.description: Service region. mainland: China Mainland, global: International

num_outputs.description:
Number of images to generate in a single request.

- When `enable_sequential=false`, the supported range is 1 to 4.
- When `enable_sequential=true`, up to 12 outputs are supported. The actual outputs is determined by the model and shall not exceed `num_outputs`.

enable_sequential.description:
Enable sequential group-image generation mode.

When enabled:
- `color_palette` is not supported.
- Supports generating up to 12 images in sequence.

color_palette.description:
Custom color theme configuration.

An array of color objects containing a HEX color value and its composition ratio.

Requirements:
- Must contain between 3 and 10 colors.
- Using around 8 colors is recommended.
- Only available when `enable_sequential=false`.

bbox_list.description:
Interactive editing bounding box regions.

The length of this list must match the number of input images in `img_urls`.

For images that do not require editing, pass an empty array `[]`.

Each bounding box uses the coordinate format:
`[x1, y1, x2, y2]`

Where:
- `x1`, `y1` = top-left corner coordinates
- `x2`, `y2` = bottom-right corner coordinates
- Coordinates use absolute pixel positions based

audio_url.description: URL of the reference music file url. Ensure the uploaded audio does not exceed 8 minutes in length.

mode.description: Music generation mode.

model.description: Use `v6`, `v6_mini`, or `v6_wild`. Legacy values (`v5.5`, `v5`, `v4.5plus`, `v4.5`, `v4.5all`, and `v4`) are deprecated; they remain accepted for compatibility but are normalized to `v6`.

instrumental.description: Whether to generate instrumental-only audio (no lyrics).

title.description: Song title for `custom` mode only. Required in `custom` mode; maximum 100 characters.

tags.description: Music style tags for `custom` mode only. Required in `custom` mode; maximum 1,000 characters.

negative_tags.description: Music styles to exclude in `custom` mode only. Only the first 200 characters are applied.

style_weight.description: Style reference strength for `custom` mode only, from 0.0 to 1.0.

audio_weight.description: Balance weight for audio features, from 0.0 to 1.0. Optional in both modes.

weirdness_constraint.description: Controls experimental or creative deviation in `custom` mode only, from 0.0 to 1.0.

duration.description: Music duration in seconds for `custom` mode only.

variety.description: Controls generation diversity and stylistic variation. Effective only in `custom` mode. Values: `0` = off, `1` = normal, `2` = high, `3` = extra, `4` = max.

persona_id.description: Persona ID for `custom` mode only. Create one via [Suno Persona Generate](/suno-api/suno-persona-generate).

persona_model.description: Persona type for `custom` mode only. Use it with `persona_id` to apply a saved persona. `style_persona` focuses on style; `voice_persona` focuses on voice.

callback_url.description:

inputs.description:
Input parameters for separating vocals and instrumentals.

Rules:
- `task_id` is required and must reference a completed Suno music task.
- `suno_id` is required and must reference the music item within that task.
- `mode` defaults to `vocal`.

mode.description:
Separation mode, different mode affect the return of task results.

- **vocal**: Extract the vocals + instrumental stem.
- **instrumental**: Extract the up to 12 stems – Vocals, Backing Vocals, Drums, Bass, Guitar, Keyboard, Strings, Brass, Woodwinds, Percussion, Synth, FX/Other

inputs.description: Input parameters for video quality enhancement.

video_url.description: The URL of the video to be enhanced.

mode.description:
Enhancement mode.
- **std**: Balances processing speed and video quality; suitable for video distribution scenarios with quality enhancement.
- **pro**: Delivers ultra-high-quality enhancement with shot-level fidelity; ideal for film and professional video production workflows.

strength.description:
Enhancement intensity.
- **mild**: light (High Fidelity) applies subtle enhancement while preserving the original look and feel as closely as possible.
- **moderate**: Provides a balanced level of video quality improvement.

scene.description:
Preset configurations for quality enhancement tailored to specific video types. Supported values are as follows:

- `common`: General-purpose template  
- `ugc`: User-generated short videos  
- `short_series`: Short-form series  
- `aigc`: AI-generated content  
- `old_film`: Old film restoration

fps.description: Target frame rate. Recommended not to exceed 4× the original video.

inputs.description: Input parameters for Wan2.2 Animate Move.

img_urls.description:
Single portrait image URL used as the appearance source.

**Image Input Requirements**

- **Formats**: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, WEBP
- **Resolution**: width and height must each be within [200, 4096] pixels
- **Aspect Ratio**: must be within 1:3 to 3:1
- **File Size**: up to 5 MB
- **Content**: exactly one person, facing the camera, full face visible without occlusion, and with a moderate subject size

video_urls.description:
Single reference video URL used as the motion source.

**Video Input Requirements**

- **Recommendation**: higher reference video resolution and frame rate can improve output video quality
- **Formats**: MP4, AVI, MOV
- **Duration**: 2 to 30 seconds
- **Resolution**: width and height must each be within [200, 2048] pixels
- **Aspect Ratio**: must be within 1:3 to 3:1
- **File Size**: up to 200 MB

resolution.description:
Output quality mode.

- `480P` maps to mode `wan-std`
- `720P` maps to mode `wan-pro`

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. `auto` is valid only when a reference video is provided; when no reference video is provided, choose `1:1`, `16:9`, or `9:16`.

audio.description: Whether to keep the original reference video's audio. This field takes effect only when `reference_videos` is provided and has no effect for image-only reference generation.

Enable this option for better generation results.

img_urls.description:
Reference image used for video generation.

- Either `img_urls` or `task_id` must be provided.
- `img_urls` must contain at least one valid image URL when used.
- If both `img_urls` and `task_id` are provided, `img_urls` takes precedence and `task_id` will be ignored.

prompt.description: Optional text prompt to guide the video generation
prompt.example: Animate the image with subtle camera movement and cinematic lighting.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Supports any integer from 6 to 30.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional output aspect ratio. This parameter only takes effect in multi-image mode. For single-image generation, the output follows the aspect ratio of the input image.

task_id.description:
**Constraints**:

- `task_id` must reference a completed (`status = success`) task created by `grok-imagine/t2i` or `grok-imagine/i2i`.
